qualifications: This was a purposive search; not a systematic review or a claim about all public releases.
The word measured in a repository field may include quantities computed by drive electronics. No independent shaft torque sensor is established by a second software field.
Stroita et al. data availability points to the article and enquiries. Do not classify the paper as open raw data.
Direct PDF retrieval for Engelberth et al. returned HTML. Publication metadata only.
A PDF for Glück et al. has the canonical DOI 10.1016/j.conengprac.2010.11.003; the initial guessed .005 resolver was unrelated and excluded.
Existing EMPS, CED, KUKA industrial benchmark, dual-tank PID and 6333 backlash releases were excluded. Five unprocessed Excel companions of 3759 are not counted as verified files.
